replies.author: Storm997
replies.body:
This has turned into a argument about modesty, so heres my two cents xP

I feel like modesty is OK, but false modesty is not.  It's alright to say "I'm an OK builder" when your really pretty good, as thats really just not bragging.  But to say "I'm the worst builder that ever lived!" is false modesty.  You know logically that there's probably somebody worse then you, so theres no point in lying to get attention.  And while we're on the subject, I'm an ok builder :3  Thats not modesty though, thats just true :P
